tailoring.headline: Senior Engineer, Hybris | SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java & Spring
tailoring.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, and agile delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Engineer, Hybris
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Engineer, Hybris position at Nagarro. With over 5 years of specialized experience designing, developing, and scaling enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for global brands such as Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in Java, Spring, and headless architecture.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API & Headless Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Cloud & DevOps Execution
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, ensuring high system stability and performance.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Hybris expertise can contribute to Nagarro.

tailoring.why_company: Nagarro's reputation for delivering complex, high-impact digital engineering solutions for global enterprises strongly aligns with my technical background. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to Nagarro, collaborating with international teams to build robust, scalable e-commerce platforms that drive measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) expertise, deep Java/Spring backend skills, and proven enterprise integration experience to Nagarro's engineering team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw your Senior Engineer, Hybris opening at Nagarro. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, strong Java/Spring skills, and SAP certification, I would love to bring my expertise to your team. Based in Germany, valid permit, available from 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Engineer, Hybris - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Engineer, Hybris position at Nagarro.

With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and complex enterprise integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026, and available from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
